title: betula lenta var. lutea
intro: Betula lenta var. lutea, commonly known as Yellow Birch, is a deciduous tree species that belongs to the Betulaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, and is traditionally used to treat various conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Birch include astringent, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which make it useful in treating conditions like coughs, colds, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Yellow Birch include betulin, betulinic acid, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
